portraits.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished transparent head-only portrait for a fantasy action game's HUD. Reference image is the authoritative main-menu painting and character identity guide. Draw ONLY KAZ, the BLACK-HAIRED young man in the FRONT CENTRE wearing black with purple/gold trim. Match his exact face, warm skin, amber-brown eyes, fierce focused brows, thick swept-back tousled black hair, small loose forehead locks and dark-purple collar from the reference. Match the title painting's polished hand-painted anime JRPG illustration, elegant clean line accents, softly painted dimensional skin, fine hair highlights, warm sunlit edges, cool subtle shadows. Bust MUST stop just below the neck at a small suggestion of collar: NO torso, shoulders, arms, hands, sword or other props. Face in a calm determined neutral expression, turned only slightly three-quarter toward viewer's right, both eyes fully visible. Large centered HEAD occupying 88 percent of the square canvas, full hair silhouette and ears intact, no cropping of hair. Transparent alpha surrounding the head and neck, clean edges, no circle, no medallion, no frame, no scenery, no labels, no text, no glow. High clarity at 90px HUD display. Produce one square portrait only; preserve the identity from the supplied painting rather than inventing another hero.
